decks.notes: The deck revolves around assembling the combo with Underworld Breach, utilizing cards that can be easily recurred from the graveyard to generate infinite mana and storm count. The deck includes powerful cantrips and tutors to dig for combo pieces and protection spells such as Force of Will and Pyroblast to ensure the combo goes off without interruption. Cards like Dack Fayden and Narset, Parter of Veils provide additional utility and disruption. The main goal is to quickly and efficiently set up the combo and win the game through a massive Brain Freeze or Bolas's Citadel storm turn.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly. It utilizes a variety of card selection and card advantage spells to find the combo pieces efficiently, while also using disruptive cards like Force of Will and Duress to protect the combo. The deck also includes powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key cards when needed. Additionally, the deck includes some powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain additional advantage and push towards victory.

The deck is focused on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful card draw and counter spells to control the game while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats and keep the opponent off balance. By combining card advantage, tempo plays, and versatile threats, this UR Aggro deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck aims to consistently and efficiently utilize the Underworld Breach combo in order to generate a powerful win condition. By leveraging various card draw and tutor effects, as well as counter magic for protection, the deck can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to execute the combo and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and resilience to the strategy, making it a formidable force in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures such as Basking Rootwalla and Bloodghast in order to cast powerful threats like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine. By utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time, the deck aims to aggressively attack the opponent while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor. The deck also includes mana acceleration through Moxen and lands like Bazaar of Baghdad, allowing for explosive plays and board control.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through card advantage and disruption while assembling a powerful win condition. It utilizes powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Demonic Tutor to gain card advantage and search for key pieces like Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault. The inclusion of counter spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm help protect the game plan, while cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Bazaar of Baghdad, allowing for powerful plays such as casting Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine for little to no mana cost. The deck also utilizes aggressive creatures like Hollow One and Basking Rootwalla to apply early pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor help to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ensure victory through fast and explosive aggression.

The deck focuses on using aggressive artifacts to quickly disrupt and control the opponent while bringing out powerful threats like Karn, Golos, and Lodestone Golem. It aims to lock down the opponent's resources with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst, while utilizing cards like Helm of Obedience and Mirage Mirror for flexibility and versatility. The deck also includes key artifact lands like Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy to ramp up its mana production, making it difficult for the opponent to keep up with its speed and efficiency.

This Doomsday combo deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces - Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle - to win the game in a single turn. The deck utilizes a variety of card draw spells and tutors to find its combo pieces, backed up by a suite of powerful counterspells to protect the combo from disruption. By leveraging powerful cards like Time Walk, Ancestral Recall, and Necropotence, the deck is able to quickly set up its win condition and outmaneuver opponents in the Vintage format.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combos enabled by [[Underworld Breach]] to quickly and efficiently generate card advantage and win the game. By using cards like [[Brain Freeze]], [[Tinker]], and [[Demonic Tutor]] to find and play key pieces, such as [[Bolas's Citadel]] or [[Black Lotus]], the deck aims to create explosive turns that overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes various control elements like [[Force of Will]] and [[Flusterstorm]] to protect its key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing powerful draw spells like [[Ancestral Recall]] and [[Treasure Cruise]] to help fuel the combo engine.

The concept of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, triggering powerful graveyard-based effects like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam to swarm the board with creatures, overwhelming the opponent. This deck utilizes cards like Serum Powder and Bazaar of Baghdad to dig through the deck and set up explosive turns. Force of Will, Force of Vigor, and Force of Negation provide disruption and protection for the combo pieces. The goal is to outpace the opponent and win through a combination of speed and resilience.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to recycle powerful spells from the graveyard, enabling explosive combos and overwhelming opponents with a variety of disruptive and fast-paced plays. Key cards like Brain Freeze, Tinker, and Bolas's Citadel work in conjunction with the Underworld Breach engine to quickly win games or lock opponents out of the game entirely. The deck is packed with efficient card draw, counterspells, and tutors to ensure consistency and resilience, while also providing enough flexibility to adapt to different matchups and strategies.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Hollow One in order to bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Master of Death. The deck also utilizes cards like Noxious Revival and Serum Powder to manipulate the graveyard and find key pieces. With a mix of counter spells like Force of Will and removal like Force of Vigor, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while maintaining a strong aggressive presence on the board.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and disruptive spells while utilizing the Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. It also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disruption, ultimately winning the game through a combination of control and early creature advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Basking Rootwalla, Bloodghast, and Vengevine. By utilizing cards like Deathrite Shaman and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis, the deck aims to keep a steady stream of threats on the battlefield. Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time help to dig for key pieces while Force of Vigor provides removal and disruption. The inclusion of Bazaar of Baghdad allows for card advantage and graveyard manipulation. Overall, the strategy is to quickly build a board presence and maintain pressure to outpace the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures such as Bloodghast, Vengevine, and Hogaak using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Bazaar of Baghdad. By leveraging this graveyard recursion strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and powerful creatures while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe.
